zh: 选中一个类型就要拿走它的全部服务器，所以真正的决策单位是“类型”，每个类型的价值就是它全部健康值之和。
健康值都为正，类型之间没有其他约束；如果选了某类却放弃了总和更大的另一类，交换后不会更差。所以应选总和最大的若干类。
按类型编号累加健康值；把各类总和降序排序，取前 m 个相加（类型不足 m 个就全取）；用 64 位整数输出。
en: Choosing a type takes all of its servers, so the real decision unit is the type, and a type's value is the sum of all its health values.
Health values are positive and types do not constrain each other; if you took a type but skipped another with a larger total, swapping them is never worse. So take the types with the largest totals.
Accumulate health per type id; sort the type totals in descending order and add the first m (all of them if there are fewer than m types); print the 64-bit sum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sum the health values per type, sort the type totals in descending order and take the first m types.

## Proof of correctness

Each type is either taken completely or not at all, there are no other constraints between types, and health values are positive. If a selected type had a smaller total than an unselected one, swapping them would not make things worse. So one can always take the at most m types with the largest totals.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
